question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: Blow hot and cold
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1**, i.e., "To shift opinions repeatedly". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Blow hot and cold"** means to be inconsistent in opinions, attitudes, or behavior; to alternate between two different states or positions. (बार-बार राय बदलना) • **Example:** He kept blowing hot and cold about whether he wanted to take the job or not, leaving everyone confused. • The correct meaning of the idiom aligns with Option 1, which is "To shift opinions repeatedly". (बार-बार राय बदलना) • **Example:** The politician was criticized for blowing hot and cold on the issue of environmental policies. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: To brag excessively** (अत्यधिक डींग मारना): This means to boast or talk about achievements in an exaggerated way. • **Example:** He kept bragging excessively about his new car, annoying everyone in the room. • **Option 3: To alternate success and failure** (सफलता और विफलता में बदलाव): Refers to a situation where one experiences both success and failure intermittently. • **Example:** His career has been a mix of alternating success and failure over the years. • **Option 4: To behave predictably** (पूर्वानुमानित तरीके से व्यवहार करना): Refers to someone acting in a way that can be easily anticipated. • **Example:** She behaves predictably in every situation, always following a routine. 35:Tc08, The correct answer is: **Provocative**.
